what: One roster entry per ABILITY — champion, slot and ability name — because champion+slot is not unique: 58 slots hold 130 abilities between them. Each entry carries the rank axis the source states, so a form sitting in another form's slot is not stored against that slot's rank count.

provenance.source: build/proposed-curated/ability-wikitext.json (the alias-deduped wiki templates, DATA-SOURCES §11) for every rank statement; public/data/champions.json for Data Dragon's per-slot maxrank (DATA-SOURCES §22); curated/curated-data.json read for comparison only and never written. Alias names resolved live against the wiki API.

definitions.key: champion|slot|abilityName. Verified unique over both source sets on 2026-08-15: 937 wiki pages and 919 override-file entries, zero collisions.
definitions.ranks: How many ranks THIS ABILITY has, which is not always the slot's. Taken from the ability's own rank-axis sentence where it has one, else from a rank-count suffix that agrees with Data Dragon, else from Data Dragon's maxrank for the slot. A suffix that disagrees with Data Dragon and is corroborated by nothing is REPORTED and never stored — see rank-shape.ts for the two cases that rule exists for.
definitions.unlockLevels: Champion levels at which each rank becomes available, ONLY where a source states them. Null means this file does not know — not that the ordinary schedule applies.
definitions.aliases: Other names the wiki redirects onto this entry. Resolved live against the wiki on 2026-08-15: each of the 134 names with no page of its own was requested with redirects followed.
definitions.curated: What the protected override file stores for the same ability, carried so a disagreement is visible. This pipeline never writes that file.
definitions.reports: Findings for a person. Nothing in this file was written on the strength of one; a report means the value shown is the uncontested one and the contested reading was recorded rather than applied.

championRankStatements.what: Sentences about how a CHAMPION ranks, read by a person and applied to nothing. They are why the seven champions above have no level curve, and each names the decision it is waiting on. `foundOnPage` false would mean the source no longer says it.

statement.quote: cannot improve his abilities via [[Experience (champion)|skill points]]
statement.means: Aphelios spends skill points on bonus attack damage, attack speed or lethality — the six-step track his passive's own leveling rows show. His Q, W and E are not rankable at all; he gains them at levels 1 and 2, and his ultimate improves automatically at 11 and 16.
statement.wouldChange: Data Dragon reports maxrank 6 for his Q, W and E, which is the STAT track and not the abilities. Believing it costs 21 skill points, so no legal build exists and his level curve computes nothing. Deciding that an unrankable ability has one rank is a modelling decision (it changes what the rank control shows), so it is raised, not taken.

statement.quote: begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic {{tip|abilities}} each have 6 ranks
statement.means: Transform is free at level 1 and never ranked; the six-rank basics are paid for.
statement.wouldChange: Already applied to the ability itself: Transform is stored with 1 rank unlocked at level 1, which Data Dragon corroborates. What is NOT applied is the skill-point consequence — his real cost is 18, not 19.

statement.quote: starts with a skill point in ''You and Me!''
statement.means: Yuumi is given her W at level 1, and her Q has six ranks instead of five.
statement.wouldChange: Her slot maxima sum to 19 and her real cost is 18. Nothing here models a free rank, so her level curve stays empty.

statement.quote: begins the game with one rank in ''Mantra''
statement.means: Mantra is free at level 1 and her empowered abilities follow its rank — which IS applied, to Soulflare, Renewal and Defiance.
statement.wouldChange: The page does not say at which levels Mantra ranks up, so no schedule was written for it. Elise and Nidalee state theirs and got one.

statement.means: NOTHING. Every Udyr page was searched on 2026-08-15 for a statement about ranks, unlock levels or skill points, and there is none.
statement.wouldChange: His four abilities each rank to 6, costing 24 of 18 skill points, so no maxed build exists — that is a true fact about Udyr rather than a data defect, and it is the one case of the seven that no source statement will fix.

statementPagesRechecked.what: Every page a rank statement was read from, re-fetched live and compared against the cached text this file was built from. A changed statement means the count must be re-read, not that it was corrected here.

reports: Aphelios/P The Hitman and the Seer: an {{ap|…}} body states a rank count of 6 and Data Dragon states none for this slot, so there is nothing to corroborate it against — reported, not stored
Aurelion Sol/Q Breath of Light: an {{ap|…}} body states a rank count of 4 while Data Dragon says 5 for the slot, and nothing corroborates the difference — kept at 5 and reported rather than changed

Heimerdinger/Q H-28Q Apex Turret: the override file stores 5 ranks for this ability and the source states 3 — the override file is not written by this pipeline, so the difference is reported here and changed nowhere. It carries 0 damage components.
Karma/Q Soulflare: states more than one rank count (4 and 5) in one leveling row, so the row mixes rank axes: a single rank count cannot express it

Karma/W Renewal: the override file stores 5 ranks for this ability and the source states 4 — the override file is not written by this pipeline, so the difference is reported here and changed nowhere. It carries 0 damage components.

Karma/E Defiance: the override file stores 5 ranks for this ability and the source states 4 — the override file is not written by this pipeline, so the difference is reported here and changed nowhere. It carries 0 damage components.
Zilean/E Time Warp: an {{ap|…}} body states a rank count of 4 while Data Dragon says 5 for the slot, and nothing corroborates the difference — kept at 5 and reported rather than changed

11 ability names the wiki's champion module lists have no template at all, so nothing can be read for them: Milio/W Cozy Campfire 2, Samira/P splash coin, Shyvana/Q Emberstrike 2, Shyvana/Q Emberstrike 3, Shyvana/W Inferno Aegis 2, Viktor/P Glorious Evolution 2, Viktor/P Glorious Evolution 3, Viktor/P Glorious Evolution 4, Viktor/P Glorious Evolution 5, Viktor/R Arcane Storm 3, Yuumi/Q Prowling Projectile 2

7 champions have slot maxima summing above the 18 skill points a level-18 champion has: Aphelios 21, Elise 19, Jayce 19, Karma 19, Nidalee 19, Udyr 24, Yuumi 19. Four of them hold an ability from level 1 without paying for it, which this index records as unlock levels where the source states them; Udyr's 24 is not of that kind and simply cannot be maxed.
